title: Unlikely man
author: Sulekha Sarkar
text:
Wiping the glycerin from the eyes,
You offered a cup of tea.
The time is summer,
In the skins of Summer the cameraman
to make a realistic documentary puts forward.
Sky in the place of sky,
Soil in place of soil,
Some Messy grasses and leaves
were left over the same way.
Eventually overcoming many distances
You also reached me.
Sex is sitting on ideologies
Yet a strange desire,
You bought me a book fair.
